widths.note: 12' at Linn end, 10' at Cutter end
label at Linn end reads 16' (could be 15'); 14'6" at Cutter end

notes: North is up. Main area Linn to Cutter, Armory Av. (EVERETT) to Hopkins; block outlines of sheets 72, 74, 81 and 61/62 are drawn round it. Jones comes down from sheet 81 and ends at Armory Av. Clayers Alley and Stephenson Alley open onto Linn from the east only (no alley on the sheet-72 side) but continue east of Cutter. Wise Alley crosses both Linn and Cutter. Block 3 (Betts-Laurel): Gones Alley (x~1357, printed 'GONES ... ALLEY' reading up the alley) and Peru Alley (x~2821, printed 'PERU ... ALLEY') each run Betts to Laurel; Joseph Alley (14'6") runs between them only and stops at both, so it does not reach Linn or Cutter. 'COURT' printed beside the lot at the Cutter end of Clayers Alley (x~3206, y~1150) is a lot label, not a street. Cutter carries two 12" water pipes (x~3266 and ~3307); centre taken between block lines x~3187 and ~3361.
